cases.reply: The pool key identifies all liquidity owned by the shared manager at those ticks, so assets includes liquidity belonging to other vaults.
Pricing shares from aggregate manager liquidity overvalues this vault and undercredits the new deposit.
The ownership boundary is missing from the asset lookup: the shared tick position is larger than this vault's claim.
Either a packed-hash collision or the shared position accounting explains the missing shares.
The first depositor donates assets until a later deposit rounds down to zero shares.
abi.encodePacked omits field boundaries, allowing different managers and tick ranges to collide and corrupt the vault price.
